message.content:
The U.S. Declaration of Independence was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies on July 4, 1776. The signers were:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, Thomas McKean |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Dickinson, George Clymer, James Smith, George Ross, Benjamin Rush, Robert Morris, John Morton |
| **New Jersey** | John Witherspoon, William Livingston, John Hart |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Samuel Adams, John Adams, Joseph Hewes, William Hooper, Joseph Jones |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, George Wythe |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, James Monroe, Thomas Jefferson, Richard Henry Lee, Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, John Jay |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | William Ellery, Stephen Hopkins, Thomas Tillinghast |

These men, representing the colonies, affixed their signatures to the Declaration, formally declaring the colonies independent from Great Britain.
